秦书简对着程安那双勾人魂魄的眸子，满怀感激的点了点小脑袋。程安满意的揉了揉她的头发，才靠回到椅背上，继续补眠。秦书简眼睛一眨不眨的盯着电影屏幕，时不时抬手摸一摸自己的心口。后半段电影演了什么，她完全没有看进去。也不知道怎么回事，从……那会儿开始，她的心就一直扑通扑通的跳个不停。她就像是揣着只小兔子一样，等到从电影院里出来的时候，一张小脸都被那只小兔子给跳的红扑扑的。程安注意到她那已经变成了桃粉色的脸颊，手在她额头上碰了碰，“热到了？”秦书简不好意思说自己一直心跳个不停，只能顺着他的话点了点头。程安盯着她看了两秒，对着她说了句：“等着。”然后走到甜品店里，买了两只甜筒出来，将其中一只递到了秦书简面前。秦书简被投喂的多了，也差不多习惯了，她下意识的伸手要去接，却听程安说，“张嘴。”秦书简不明所以，呆呆的张了嘴。然后直接被塞了一大口的冰激凌。她鼓着腮帮子，被突然入口的冰凉冰的瞪大了眼睛。程安捏着甜筒，看着秦书简唇上被蹭上的冰激凌，勾了勾唇角。这才将甜筒递到她手里。腾出了一只手的程安，手指落在秦书简的唇上，轻轻的蹭了蹭。对着秦书简瞪的更大了的眼睛，他无比淡定的说了句：“我看你吃个冰激凌吃的满嘴都是，帮你擦一下。”秦书简疑惑的跟着也抬手蹭了蹭唇角，心想，我吃的吗？好像是哦。等到秦书简将自己手里的甜筒吃光了，程安直接把自己那只才咬了一口的甜筒递给她，并且说道：“我发现我不喜欢吃甜的，请你帮个忙吃了吧。”秦书简丝毫没觉得有哪里不对，看着程安那只都快化掉了的冰激凌甜筒，她一边吃一边想着，这么好吃为什么不喜欢甜的？他可真挑剔。程安看着身旁的小姑娘咬着自己咬过的冰激凌，唇角不自觉的翘了翘。她愿意跟他吃同一个冰激凌，那肯定是喜欢他的吧。刚刚在电影院里，他说她是她男人的时候，她也没反对。程安想着刚刚那个吻，唇角的笑容又扩大了些。他看着时间差不多了，带着秦书简去了早就提前订好的餐厅。偌大的包厢里面，只有他们两个人。程安没有点太多的菜，但是特地给她点了一碗寿面。还叫服务员去取了他一早就订好的蛋糕。还开了两瓶香槟，两瓶红酒，跟几瓶啤酒。摆了满满的一桌子。他一只手支着下巴，手指敲了敲桌子，冲着秦书简勾了勾他那双妖孽的眸子，“小简单，我给你一个道谢的机会。”ps：求月票哦~

Qin Shujian looked at Cheng An's captivating eyes and nodded his head gratefully. Cheng An rubbed her hair with satisfaction before leaning back on the chair and continuing to catch up on her sleep. Qin Shujian stared at the movie screen without blinking, raising his hand to touch his heart from time to time. She didn't notice what was going on in the second half of the movie. She didn't know what was going on, but from that moment on, her heart kept beating. It was like she was carrying a little rabbit. When she came out of the cinema, her little face was bright red from the little rabbit. Cheng An noticed that her cheeks had turned peachy pink, and touched her forehead with his hand, "Is it too hot?" Qin Shujian was embarrassed to say that her heart was beating all the time, so she could only nod along with his words. Cheng An stared at her for two seconds and said to her, "Wait." Then he walked to the dessert shop, bought two cones, and handed one of them to Qin Shujian. Qin Shujian had been fed a lot, and she was almost used to it. She subconsciously reached out to pick it up, but heard Cheng An say, "Open your mouth." Qin Shujian didn't know why, and opened her mouth blankly. Then I was stuffed with a big mouthful of ice cream. She puffed out her cheeks and her eyes widened at the sudden cold entrance. Cheng An held the cone, looked at the ice cream on Qin Shujian's lips, and curled up the corners of his lips. Then he handed the cone into her hand. With one hand free, Cheng An placed his fingers on Qin Shujian's lips and rubbed them gently. Facing Qin Shujian's widened eyes, he said very calmly: "I saw your mouth was full of ice cream when you ate it. I'll help you wipe it." Qin Shujian raised his hand and rubbed the corner of his lips in confusion, thinking, did I eat it? It seems so. When Qin Shujian finished eating the cone in his hand, Cheng An handed her the cone that he had just taken a bite of and said, "I found that I don't like sweet things. Please do me a favor and eat it." Qin Shujian didn't feel anything was wrong at all. She looked at Cheng An's ice cream cone that was almost melted. As she ate, she thought, why don't she like sweet things when it's so delicious? He's so picky. Cheng An watched the little girl next to him bite the ice cream he had bitten, and the corners of his lips curled up unconsciously. If she is willing to eat the same ice cream with him, she must like him. Just now in the cinema, when he said she was her man, she didn't object. Cheng An thought about the kiss just now, and the smile on his lips grew wider. Seeing that the time was almost up, he took Qin Shujian to the restaurant he had booked in advance. There were only two of them in the huge box. Cheng An didn't order too many dishes, but he specially ordered a bowl of longevity noodles for her. He also asked the waiter to pick up the cake he ordered early in the morning. I also opened two bottles of champagne, two bottles of red wine, and a few bottles of beer. A full table was set. He supported his chin with one hand, tapped the table with his fingers, and raised his evil eyes at Qin Shujian, "Xiao Jian, I'll give you a chance to say thank you." ps: Please vote for me~
